Thursday was a rough session for Jaleel's book, with the portfolio's overall unrealized gain sitting at 4.12% and most holdings finishing in the red. The biggest drag came from Boston Scientific (BSX), which shed 5.08% on the day — a serious move for a nearly 10% weight, and one that lands squarely on top of an already-elevated risk flag: management has guided flat through Q3 after slashing FY26 growth targets from 10.5% down to 7–8.5%. That thesis is under active stress, not just noise. On Holding (ONON) fell 4.35%, Rocket Lab (RKLB) dropped 3.81%, AutoZone (AZO) gave back 3.73%, and Lululemon (LULU) slid another 3.15% — the latter now sitting at a –9.5% unrealized loss with a guidance cut already on the books and the next earnings catalyst not until September 2. The one bright spot was Danaher (DHR), which gained 2.09% and now carries a healthy 20.2% unrealized gain, and S&P Global (SPGI) added 1.29%.

The drift worth flagging is in ZTS and BSX specifically. Zoetis (ZTS) carries a STRONG BUY verdict with a QARP score of 72.6 yet is in the red on an unrealized basis (–4.7%) and fell another 2.16% today — price and thesis are pulling apart. BSX is the same story but more acute: the guidance slash is a fundamental event, not sentiment. On the positive side, Adobe (ADBE) was nearly flat (–0.09%) and caught a tailwind from B of A raising price targets across software names on easing AI-disruption concerns — a direct counter to the narrative risk flagged on the name. NVDA dipped only 0.33% despite a mixed tape for semiconductors.

Watch the cluster of consumer names (ONON, LULU, AZO) — three separate businesses, but all moving together today in a way that suggests macro/consumer-sentiment pressure rather than company-specific news. RKLB remains the uncomfortable outlier: an AVOID verdict, a –6.9% unrealized loss, a 7.2% weight, and another down day. That combination deserves an honest look at what the exit plan is. NVDA's next earnings are August 26 — that event will set the tone for the AI-capex narrative and ripple through the book's tech exposure.

attention.headline: Guidance slashed + 5% single-day drop demands a position review
attention.note: With FY26 growth cut to 7–8.5% and management guiding flat through Q3, today's –5.08% move is not noise — the thesis has changed materially and the next update isn't until October 20.

attention.headline: AVOID-rated name with a –6.9% loss took another 3.81% hit today
attention.note: A 7.2% weight carrying an AVOID verdict and a growing unrealized loss with no apparent catalyst for recovery is a capital-preservation red flag that needs an explicit hold-or-exit decision.

attention.headline: Guidance-cut stock down another 3.15%; –9.5% unrealized loss deepening
attention.note: Americas comps down five straight quarters and tariff margin pressure are structural, not transient — the September 2 print is the next chance to reassess, but the loss is compounding.

attention.headline: Earnings August 26 will stress-test the AI-capex narrative for the whole book
attention.note: Export-control risk is live and today's tape showed semiconductor weakness on OpenAI earnings concerns; the outcome next Tuesday will directly affect NVDA's 9.4% weight and broader sentiment on AI spending.
